text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Right on schedule, I got a perfect amount 
of rest and sleep, planned down to the 
minute."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, there are no issues with my 
stamina. It seems I will be able to 
complete today's menu as planned.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. I'm already looking forward to our 
training session.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Eishin Flash was able to get 
plenty of rest!
